dag_infos.description: New Taipei district fertility rates from MOI RIS ODRP116, with ODRP115 mid-year currently married women counts and shares as denominator context. Rates are retained exactly as published and no rate is summed or population-scaled.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市生育率與年中有偶婦女（按年齡、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP116/ODRP115)
data_infos.dataset_description: ODRP116提供新北市各行政區總生育率、一般生育率及年齡別生育率；ODRP115提供年中有偶婦女人數與其占同年齡婦女比例。實測兩者均只有民國113至114資料，民國113新北缺板橋區。總生育率來源值為乘1000後的數字，例如民國114板橋560；年齡別生育率為每千名同年齡婦女。
data_infos.etl_description: Probe ROC years using the RIS responseCode, not HTTP status: OD-0102-S is a successful HTTP 200 no-data response. Normalize the English and Chinese schemas by semantic aliases because ROC 113 uses Chinese column names. Keep ODRP116 rate cells and ODRP115 count/share cells at district grain. The TFR identity TFR = 5 times the sum of seven five-year ASFR cells is checked for every district/year; no fertility rate is added across districts or ages, and no 18-35 rate is materialized. A three-times-median annual scale guard is applied separately to ODRP116 rate medians and ODRP115 count totals. The known ROC 113 missing Banqiao district is retained only with source_incomplete metadata; unknown missing districts fail loudly.
